verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is Cursor's account-wide Privacy Mode. Users can enable it, or a team admin can, and new team members inherit it. It only promises that Cursor will not train on your data, which is a training opt-out, not a documented opt-out of telemetry or usage tracking, and nothing ties it specifically to Bugbot. Missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out, documentation of what Bugbot collects and how Privacy Mode applies to Bugbot reviews, and independent corroboration.
